races.title: State Assembly, District 41
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: John Harabedian
cands.bio: Democrat who has represented California's 41st Assembly District since December 2024. Attorney and partner at Ellis George LLP. Former Los Angeles County deputy district attorney and Latham & Watkins associate. Served on the Sierra Madre City Council and as its mayor.

endorsements.text: Ballotpedia lists these 2026 endorsements: Democratic Party of California, California Federation of Labor Unions (AFL-CIO), California Teachers Association, California Nurses Association, National Union of Healthcare Workers, California Environmental Voters, Equality California, Sierra Club Angeles Chapter and YIMBY Action.

cands.gaps: The pages we had show no stated positions or actions by Harabedian on data centers, homestead property tax, foreign or investor land purchases, growth limits, H-1B or immigration enforcement, donor money, police pay, gun laws, abortion or school choice. We found no documented stance on data centers or new development, and no controversies in the sources. Ballotpedia's list of bills he sponsored was empty on the page we read. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey, so there is no questionnaire to draw on. Wikipedia gives no date for his move to any other place, which fits his being born and raised in Sierra Madre.

local.label: Roots 100: Wikipedia says he was born and raised in Sierra Madre, California, and Ballotpedia lists Sierra Madre as his birthplace.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Assembly member since December 2024. Earlier he was a Sierra Madre city councilmember (elected 2012, re-elected 2016) and a two-term mayor. His legal career includes a Los Angeles County deputy district attorney role, a Latham & Watkins associate role, a federal district court clerkship and a partnership at Ellis George LLP.
qual.why: He has prior legislative service in the Assembly, plus local elected office and a law career. That fits the high band for writing law and the budget. Chairing the Legislative Audit Committee was not counted.

cands.name: Adam Christopher Vena
cands.bio: Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 41 in 2026. He advanced from the June 2026 primary and lost the November 2026 general election to incumbent Democrat John Harabedian. No other background was found.

endorsements.text: Ballotpedia lists endorsements and voter-guide recommendations from Reform California, The Morning Answer with Jennifer Horn, April's Common Sense Cali Voters, Based in Malibu, and Elizabeth Barcohana's Lady with a Brain Voter Guide.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Adam Vena was born or raised, when he came to California, or his job history and any offices he has held. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, and we found no campaign site, interviews or questionnaires stating his positions. We found no documented actions or statements on data centers, development, property taxes, immigration, guns, abortion, schools, policing or land ownership. We found no news reports of controversies or foreign ties.
